market_sources.name: AWS S3 Object Integrity and Object Lock
AWS S3 Object Integrity and Object Lock

records.label: Backup UUID / Label / Note / Tags
records.notes: Generated UUID plus optional bounded label (default "Manual backup — <local datetime>"), normalized tags and internal note; note is excluded from filenames/provider keys unless sanitized separately. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.2, §3 Step 1; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Backup Set.

records.label: Trigger (Manual / Scheduled / Pre-Reset / Pre-Restore / Pre-Update / Imported)
records.notes: Trigger is recorded truth, fixed to manual in the ordinary wizard; pre-reset/pre-restore triggers come from the destructive workflow that requires the restore point. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.2, §3 Step 1; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Backup Set.

records.label: Backup Set Lifecycle State
records.notes: queued/preparing/capturing_database/capturing_files/packaging/verifying_local/uploading/verifying_remote/completed_verified/completed_partial/failed/cancelled/pruned; UI may simplify but internal state keeps truth and completed_partial is never a plain green success. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Backup states; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §1.

records.label: Verification Tier V0 Generated / V1 Local / V2 Remote / V3 Restore Tested
records.notes: Tiered recovery confidence instead of a single "Success"; V3 is a certification/staging outcome and a stale V3 never proves current remote presence. No native or common-market equivalent. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Backup verification tiers; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-REMOTE-COPY-LIFECYCLE.md §9.

records.label: Protect From Retention / Create As Restore Point
records.notes: Protect toggle default off for ordinary manual backups; restore-point flag default off unless invoked by a destructive workflow; protected sets are never auto-pruned. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 1, §4 Retention.

records.label: Backup Sets List Columns / Filters / Search
records.notes: Filter by status, trigger, scope, encryption, verification tier, destination, protected flag, date, source environment and warnings; search label/UUID/notes/tags and safe object references only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.2.

records.label: Row / Bulk Actions (Verify, Protect, Copy, Delete, Manifest Report)
records.notes: Destructive bulk operations require impact preview and cannot delete the only known verified recovery point when active policy forbids it; artifact download requires capability/policy. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.2.

records.label: Overview Cards / Quick Actions
records.notes: Permission-filtered last success, last verified tier, next run, protected points, destination health, failed/partial count, temp usage, runner health, encryption readiness, latest restore, alerts. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.1.

records.label: Plan Name / Key / Enabled / Description / Tags / Priority
records.notes: Required name and stable generated key editable before first publish per common contract; enabled/paused/degraded status; plan actions Edit/Duplicate/Run Now/Pause/Validate/Export/Archive. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.3, §4 General.

records.label: Schedule (Manual / One-time / Hourly / Daily / Weekly / Monthly / Custom)
records.notes: WP-Cron (wp_schedule_event) is native substrate only, executed through the canonical Job Service (Surface 18); preferred local time, weekday/month day, site timezone default, DST preview; hourly only when intentionally chosen. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Schedule; docs/PRODUCT/BACKUP-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md ownership.

records.label: Missed Run / Overlap / Expected Duration
records.notes: Missed run: run once ASAP default / skip / bounded catch-up; overlap prevented by default; maximum expected duration hint and runner health warning. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Schedule.

records.label: Plan Environment Restrictions
records.notes: Marked "optional future" by the spec; deferred until environment identity/staging (Surface 55) contracts exist. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 General.

records.label: Scope Preset (Database / Content+Uploads / Full / WPE Config / Files / Custom)
records.notes: Changing a preset populates explicit selections and the UI shows exactly what will be captured; WPE configuration scope uses the portable package service (Surface 26), not a full DB dump. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 2; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Scope options.

records.label: Include Database / Table Selection Mode (All WP / Prefix / Custom)
records.notes: wpdb table prefix and site/network table metadata are native substrate; WPE custom tables and Custom Tables Builder tables are explicit toggles; non-prefix tables off by default with explicit selection. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 3; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Database only.

records.label: Exclude Transient / Cache Table Categories
records.notes: Only where the adapter recognizes safe categories; default off until the user chooses; row/data filters are not part of full backup (logical selective export belongs to Import/Export). Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 3.

records.label: Include Views / Triggers / Routines
records.notes: Displayed only when the DB adapter supports it and certification exists; deferred until a certified DB adapter profile is accepted. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 3; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-ARTIFACT-CONTAINER-COMPRESSION-HASH-PROFILE.md §13.

records.label: Chunk/Stream Mode / Consistency Strategy / Charset-Collation Metadata
records.notes: Automatic chunk/stream default; consistent snapshot where engine supports, table locks only where safe; charset/collation is mandatory metadata, not a toggle; warnings for huge/non-transactional tables, missing privileges, unsupported objects. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 3; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Consistency model.

records.label: Achieved Consistency Level Disclosure
records.notes: WPE states the consistency level actually achieved and never claims a globally atomic DB+files snapshot on ordinary hosting; cross DB/files drift is documented. Not offered by native or common market tools. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Consistency model.

records.label: File Roots (Uploads / Plugins / Themes / MU-Plugins / Languages / wp-content / Core / Custom)
records.notes: wp_upload_dir(), WP_CONTENT_DIR, get_plugins() and wp_get_themes() are the native substrate; WordPress core optional rather than assumed; custom paths only within an approved root. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 4; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Full WordPress site candidate.

records.label: Include Inactive Plugins / Themes
records.notes: Native active/inactive inventory (get_plugins, wp_get_themes) drives the toggle; bounded optional choice. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 4.

records.label: Default Exclusions (Cache / Logs / Existing Archives / WPE Workspace)
records.notes: Cache and logs default off when safely detectable, existing backup archives and destination folders excluded to prevent recursive backup; never silently exclude user content by size; excluded rules recorded in the manifest. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 4; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Exclusion rules.

records.label: Custom Exclude Rules (Exact / Prefix / Bounded Glob / Extension / Size)
records.notes: Size threshold only as an explicit user rule; preview shows matched examples/count estimate where feasible. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 4.

records.label: Follow Symlinks (Off Default, Inside Site Root Only)
records.notes: Off by default; loops prevented; target path recorded safely; outside-root targets unavailable in normal mode. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 4; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Exclusion rules.

records.label: Unreadable File Policy (Fail Required Scope / Partial With Warning)
records.notes: Unresolved required capture errors prevent a fully verified label. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 4; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Mandatory manifest.

records.label: Changed-During-Read Detection / Bounded Retry
records.notes: Record stat/checksum while reading, detect volatility, bounded retry count (advanced), report unresolved volatility in the manifest. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Consistency model / Files; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 4.

records.label: Content / Application Logical Selective Backup
records.notes: Future only; must not pretend logical export equals byte-for-byte DB restore; overlaps Surface 26 Import/Export. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Content/application scope.

records.label: Container Format (Automatic / WPE Bundle / ZIP or TAR+GZIP Convenience)
records.notes: Canonical Backup Set is header + authoritative manifest + independently verifiable parts, not one ZIP; ZIP/TAR are convenience adapters only where the runtime capability and security limits are verified. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 5; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-ARTIFACT-CONTAINER-COMPRESSION-HASH-PROFILE.md §2; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-CONTAINER-ALTERNATIVES.md Current paper recommendation.

records.label: Compression Profile / Level (Fast / Balanced / Maximum)
records.notes: Native PHP zlib/zip availability probed (CMP0 none fallback, CMP1 gzip streaming, CMP2 ZIP convenience, CMP3 zstd future); per-file bypass for already-compressed media; compression before encryption. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 5; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-ARTIFACT-CONTAINER-COMPRESSION-HASH-PROFILE.md §6, §7; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Compression.

records.label: Split Archive / Part Size (Auto / Off / Custom)
records.notes: Custom part size bounded and provider-aware; chunk sizing profile governs defaults. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 5; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-ARTIFACT-CONTAINER-COMPRESSION-HASH-PROFILE.md §12; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-MANIFEST-CHUNK-PROFILE-CANDIDATE.md §8.

records.label: Temporary Workspace Path
records.notes: Read-only/advanced registry choice; the working directory can never recursively include itself; private, non-web-accessible location. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 5, §13.

records.label: Mandatory Manifest (Requested vs Captured, Exclusions, Versions, Order)
records.notes: Cannot be disabled; records schema version, requested vs captured scope, tables/files, exclusions, checksums, algorithms, prefix, URLs, multisite, plugin/theme and WPE versions, part order, failed/skipped items. Existing read-only LocalBackupManifestVerifier consumes manifest V1 (reference only). Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Mandatory manifest; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-MANIFEST-CHUNK-PROFILE-CANDIDATE.md §5; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 5.

records.label: Mandatory Checksums (SHA-256 Stored-Object Digest)
records.notes: H-B1 SHA-256 over exact stored bytes for every finalized required part; provider ETag is supplemental only; AEAD authentication and SHA-256 are never substituted for each other. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-ARTIFACT-CONTAINER-COMPRESSION-HASH-PROFILE.md §5; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 5.

records.label: Encrypt Archive (Authenticated Encryption)
records.notes: Independent of HTTPS, provider SSE and Vault encryption; reviewed AEAD container design (native Sodium requirement) with per-part encryption; lost key may make restore impossible and the UI says so before enabling. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Encryption; docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md §2-§5; docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ENCRYPTION-CRYPTO-PROFILE-CANDIDATE.md Preferred v1 data-encryption profile.

records.label: Recovery Method (Recovery Passphrase / Site-Managed Recovery Key)
records.notes: Mode B passphrase (never stored, Argon2id-class KDF never silently lowered) and Mode C site-managed recovery key with exportable recovery kit; key never stored inseparably with the archive. Evidence: docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md §5, §9; docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ENCRYPTION-CRYPTO-PROFILE-CANDIDATE.md Key slots.

records.label: Test Recovery Material Before Run / Recovery Readiness
records.notes: Recovery material is tested before an encrypted run and readiness is surfaced on Overview/details; not a common market capability. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 5, §2.1; docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md §12.

records.label: External KMS / HSM Key Adapter
records.notes: Mode D / Slot C future only; requires separate accepted design. Evidence: docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md §5 Mode D; docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ENCRYPTION-CRYPTO-PROFILE-CANDIDATE.md Slot C.

records.label: Recovery Key / DEK Rotation
records.notes: Rotation must not make old backups undecryptable (WordPress salts are not the recovery root); compromised DEK/recovery key procedures defined separately. Evidence: docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md §6, §11; docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ENCRYPTION-CRYPTO-PROFILE-CANDIDATE.md Rotation.

records.label: Incremental / Deduplicated Chain
records.notes: Content-addressed/deduplicated chunk store is Alternative D only; current recommendation is manifest + independent parts. Deferred until chain/restore-dependency semantics are accepted. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-CONTAINER-ALTERNATIVES.md Alternative D, Current paper recommendation; docs/PRODUCT/BACKUP-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md families.

records.label: Destination Name / Adapter / Enabled / Certification Notice
records.notes: Provider identity is family_key + provider_key + profile version + adapter version; numeric PF-xx aliases never persisted; listed providers are targets until certified (current certified count 0). Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-PROVIDER-FAMILY-CAPABILITY-REGISTRY.md §1; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-MATRIX.md Goal.

records.label: Credential Vault Reference (Write-Only, Replace / Revoke / Re-authorize)
records.notes: Credentials are Vault references owned with Surface 23 Connections; saved-state indicator only; never revealed. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Credential fields; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-MATRIX.md Security boundaries 1.

records.label: Endpoint / Region / Bucket / Container / Folder / Root Prefix
records.notes: Per adapter profile; custom S3/WebDAV/SFTP endpoints require explicit destination trust/SSRF policy via shared Connections policy. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-MATRIX.md Security boundaries 3.

records.label: Storage Class / Provider Server-Side Encryption
records.notes: Provider SSE is explicitly separate from WPE archive encryption. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-MATRIX.md Security boundaries 7.

records.label: Chunk Size / Timeout / Retry Profile / Upload Concurrency
records.notes: Chunk size Auto default, adapter-default timeout, retry profile; upload concurrency advanced and bounded by the Job Service. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 6, §5, §13.

records.label: Required / Optional Mirror Destinations and Success Policy
records.notes: Default: all required destinations succeed; "at least one required verified" is an advanced clearly displayed policy only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 6; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-MANIFEST-CHUNK-PROFILE-CANDIDATE.md §16.

records.label: Local Private Storage
records.notes: WP_Filesystem method and approved private roots are native substrate; free-space, permissions and web-access exposure tests; staging names then manifest last. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Local; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-LOCAL-FTP-SFTP-STATIC-PROFILES.md §3.

records.label: Manual Download / Export
records.notes: Capability + nonce authorized streaming, sanitized filename, short-lived temp artifact, never secrets in URL; not a remote retention destination and never counted as a remote copy. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-LOCAL-FTP-SFTP-STATIC-PROFILES.md §4; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 6.

records.label: S3-Compatible Family Profile
records.notes: Endpoint/region/bucket/credential ref/prefix/storage class; multipart automatic; object-lock status read-only; capability-negotiated rather than feature-inherited; TLS mandatory. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 S3-compatible family; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-PROVIDER-FAMILY-CAPABILITY-REGISTRY.md §8.1.

records.label: SFTP Profile
records.notes: Host/port 22/username/password or private key via Vault; host-key verification mandatory; remote path; keepalive adapter-managed. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 SFTP; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-LOCAL-FTP-SFTP-STATIC-PROFILES.md §7; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-MATRIX.md Security boundaries 5.

records.label: FTPS / Legacy FTP Profile
records.notes: FTPS preferred; plain FTP only as "Legacy / Insecure transport" with explicit administrator acknowledgement, Vault credentials and conditional resume. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-LOCAL-FTP-SFTP-STATIC-PROFILES.md §5, §6.

records.label: WebDAV Profile
records.notes: HTTPS endpoint strongly required, certificate validation, capability probe; Nextcloud/ownCloud are profiles, not generic guarantees. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 WebDAV; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-PROVIDER-FAMILY-CAPABILITY-REGISTRY.md §8.2.

records.label: OAuth Drive Profile (Connect / Folder / Quota / Token Health / Scopes)
records.notes: OAuth lifecycle owned by Surface 23; account safe label, target folder ID, resumable capability, quota where exposed, scopes displayed. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 OAuth drive; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-MATRIX.md Family UI contracts.

records.label: Email Small-Artifact Delivery
records.notes: Not a normal large-backup destination: manifest-only or small archive below a safety bound; fallback link only when another protected destination exists and authorization permits; explicit non-certified warning. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Email/Gmail-style small-artifact delivery.

records.label: Connection Test / Isolated Probe / Health / Usage
records.notes: Test connection and upload/download/delete in an isolated probe location where provider permits; usage by plans; delete only after dependency review; disconnect never deletes remote backups. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.4; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-MATRIX.md Security boundaries 8.

records.label: Provider Certification Level C0-C4
records.notes: A logo, OAuth success or one upload is not support; C0 connectable through C4 disaster-restore certified; static evidence SE levels never imply C-levels. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-CONTRACT.md §1, §5; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-MATRIX.md Canonical certification levels.

records.label: Remote Copy Lifecycle (Staging / Commit / Manifest-Last / Verify)
records.notes: Each destination copy has independent transfer, commit and verification state; upload started never equals stored; provider visibility never equals verified. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-REMOTE-COPY-LIFECYCLE.md §1, §3-§7.

records.label: Remote Verification Method (Automatic / Certified)
records.notes: Provider-safe method recorded in manifest; V2 requires at least one verified remote copy. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 6, Step 7; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md V2.

records.label: Target Verification Minimum / Remote Plan V2
records.notes: V1 Local Verified default for manual local backup; V2 candidate default for remote plans; immediate restore test unavailable on ordinary production sites; sample vs full method recorded. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 7, §4 Verification policy.

records.label: Delete Local Temporary Artifact After Verified Remote
records.notes: Only after verified remote upload; local manifest retained unless cleanup removes Backup Set metadata. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 7, §4 Retention.

records.label: Remote Re-Verification Cadence / Missing-Copy Response
records.notes: Metadata-only, provider checksum, sampled range, full read/hash or V3 depth labeled with time; corruption/missing copy response policy. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-REMOTE-COPY-LIFECYCLE.md §9; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Verification policy.

records.label: Auto-Copy Healthy Mirror On Required Failure
records.notes: Spec marks it future optional. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Verification policy.

records.label: Restore-Test (V3) Certification Scheduling
records.notes: Only if staging infrastructure exists (Surface 55 Staging owns the environment); future. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Verification policy, §3 Step 7; docs/PRODUCT/BACKUP-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md ownership.

records.label: Keep Last N / Keep Duration / Per-Destination Override
records.notes: Retention engine operates on Backup Set/copy truth, not raw provider folder age; policy snapshot recorded per copy. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Retention; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-REMOTE-COPY-LIFECYCLE.md §10.

records.label: Protected / Manual Restore Points / Minimum Verified Copies
records.notes: Manual/protected points never auto-deleted by default; minimum verified copies preserved; most recent verified backup preserved regardless of age. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Retention; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-REMOTE-COPY-LIFECYCLE.md §11.

records.label: GFS Daily / Weekly / Monthly Generations
records.notes: Only when the advanced feature is accepted; operates on copy truth. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Retention; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-REMOTE-COPY-LIFECYCLE.md §10.

records.label: Create + Verify Replacement Before Prune / Auditable Prune Plan
records.notes: Unless an explicit storage emergency policy says otherwise; prune checks pins, healthy-copy minimum, in-progress Reset/Restore dependency and provider object lock. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Retention; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-REMOTE-COPY-LIFECYCLE.md §11.

records.label: Prune Partial / Failed Artifacts After Duration
records.notes: Cleanup distinguishes staging/orphan parts from committed parts. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Retention; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-LOCAL-FTP-SFTP-STATIC-PROFILES.md §3.

records.label: Delete Copy / Delete Set / Metadata-Only / Retention Prune
records.notes: Deleting one copy keeps Backup Set metadata if other copies remain; typed phrase for protected/last verified copy; reason per policy; tombstone/history per audit policy; provider permission failure leaves delete_failed, not deleted. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-REMOTE-COPY-LIFECYCLE.md §12.

records.label: Notify On Success / Partial / Failure / Below-Target / Credential Health
records.notes: Failure on by default for scheduled plans; recipients via Surface 19 Notifications; email fallback only if configured; safe summary with no secrets/archive keys. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 8.

records.label: Backup Review / Preflight (Scope, Estimates, Disk, Readiness, Locks, Runner)
records.notes: Shows included/excluded scope, estimated bytes/files/tables, temp disk, destinations, encryption readiness, verification target, compatibility warnings, destructive locks and runner health before Start/Save as Plan. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 9.

records.label: Concurrency (One Run Per Plan / Site Capture / Destructive-Operation Locks)
records.notes: One run per plan and one site-wide capture by default; destination uploads parallelize only within Job Service limits; skip/queue when another destructive operation is active. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Concurrency.

records.label: Streaming / Bounded Chunks / Resumable Phases / Pagination
records.notes: Never load a full archive into PHP memory; Job Service phases resumable where safe; paginated lists/logs/provider listings; chunked retention; disk reservation estimate. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Compression.

records.label: Restore Source (Local Catalog / Remote Destination / Verified-Only Filter)
records.notes: Verified-only filter default on; restore source resolution follows remote copy truth. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7 Select source; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-REMOTE-COPY-LIFECYCLE.md §14.

records.label: Import WPE Backup Manifest / Artifact
records.notes: Future certified flow only; imported provenance must be explicit; generic package import stays Surface 26. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7 Select source; docs/PRODUCT/BACKUP-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md family 20.

records.label: Restore Preflight (Manifest, Checksums, Decryption, Disk, DB, Versions, Prefix, Locks)
records.notes: Read-only checks and blockers before any destructive phase: authentication + high-risk capability, recent re-auth, manifest/integrity, decryption key, space, DB permissions, multisite mismatch, version and plugin/theme availability, impact; failure before maintenance does not take the site offline. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Restore preflight; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7 Preflight.

records.label: Restore Scope (Full / DB / Files / Uploads / Plugin-Theme Dirs / WPE Config / Selected Tables)
records.notes: Selected tables only with accepted dependency-safe warning; selective restore only where dependency/integrity semantics are understood. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7 Scope; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Restore scopes.

records.label: Existing Files Behavior (Preserve Extras Default / Mirror With Preview)
records.notes: Restore to staging/temp, verify, prevent traversal, atomic rename where permitted, record added/replaced/removed files. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7 Existing target behavior; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md File restore semantics.

records.label: Existing Tables Behavior (Replace Selected / Temp Tables Then Swap)
records.notes: No generic merge mode; explicit target list, prefix mapping, charset/collation review, verify key tables/counts after import. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7 Existing target behavior; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Database restore semantics.

records.label: Environment Mapping (Site/Home URL, Upload Base, Paths, DB Prefix)
records.notes: home/siteurl options, upload paths and wpdb prefix are native substrate; serialization-safe typed replacement (maybe_unserialize-aware, WP-CLI search-replace precedent) enabled by default for known structures; builder/plugin data only via certified adapters. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7 Environment mapping; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md URL/path migration.

records.label: Plugin / Theme Strategy (Restore Archived / Keep Target / Per-Package)
records.notes: Explicit vulnerability and DB schema mismatch warnings; Free/Pro compatibility handled without fatal boot. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7 Plugin/theme strategy; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Plugin/theme handling.

records.label: WordPress Core Files Handling
records.notes: Core is normally reinstalled from trusted WordPress distributions; if restored, expected version verified and arbitrary executable core files never trusted. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Core files.

records.label: Pre-Restore Point (Required Default / Minimum Tier / Storage Target)
records.notes: Required by default; override only with dedicated high-risk capability plus phrase/reason where policy allows. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7 Pre-restore point; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Rollback after failed restore.

records.label: Final Explicit Confirmation (At-Risk Data / Recovery Route / Cancel Boundary)
records.notes: No destructive restore without verified backup + explicit confirmation; no promised duration. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7 Confirmation; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Restore preflight step 15.

records.label: Maintenance / Recovery Mode
records.notes: Native .maintenance / wp_maintenance() substrate; entered only when ready and left automatically only after critical post-restore checks pass. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Restore preflight step 14, Post-restore verification.

records.label: Post-Restore Verification (Core Tables, URLs, Auth, Compat, Plugins, Cron, Site Health)
records.notes: WP_Site_Health summary is native substrate; failures enter recovery/degraded mode with safe next actions. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Post-restore verification.

records.label: Restore Run States / Cancellation Boundary
records.notes: preflight → ... → completed/completed_with_warnings/failed_recoverable/failed_recovery_required/cancelled_before_destructive_phase; no fake Cancel after a commit/swap phase. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Restore status; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.5.

records.label: Failed Restore Recovery (Pre-Restore Point, No Auto Loop)
records.notes: No automatic-rollback claim unless proven for scope; preserve failure state/log/correlation ID; offer pre-restore point restore; DB transaction rollback is not universal rollback. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Rollback after failed restore.

records.label: Multisite Restore Modes (Network / Single Site / Tables / Uploads / Mappings)
records.notes: is_multisite() and network/site table relationships are native substrate; Super Admin authorization; single-to-multisite conversion is not a simple restore. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Multisite; docs/PRODUCT/BACKUP-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md family 19.

records.label: Disaster Recovery Bootstrap Runner
records.notes: Separate minimal restore runner when WordPress cannot boot; requires separate threat/distribution design; not assumed for first release. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Restore entry modes; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-CONTAINER-ALTERNATIVES.md Disaster recovery bootstrap.

records.label: Single-Site <-> Multisite Conversion
records.notes: Migration/conversion, not restore; must not be marketed without dedicated support. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Multisite.

records.label: Backup Details (Manifest, Parts, Verification, Copies, Environment, Skips, Timeline)
records.notes: Verification details show algorithm/version, local and remote results, verified timestamp, last failure, tier and V3 reference. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: Activity / Logs (Safe Metadata, Paginated, Filterable)
records.notes: Filter by backup/run/destination/phase/outcome/date; never DB row contents, secrets, private files or archive keys. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.6; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Restore observability.

records.label: Typed Backup / Verification / Upload / Prune / Restore / Health Events
records.notes: Safe typed payloads only; never archive keys/secrets/private contents. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Explicit Failure / Empty States With Next Safe Action
records.notes: No backups/plan/destination/verified point, auth expired, provider unreachable, disk low, runner unhealthy, partial, verification failed, copy missing, key unavailable, incompatibility, preflight blocked, recovery required; no silent spinner timeout. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: Granular Capabilities (wpe_backup_* incl. restore_unsafe_override)
records.notes: Read/create/plan CRUD/destination/credentials/run/cancel/verify/download/delete/restore separated; restore, credential and recovery-key operations high-risk with recent re-auth. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Abilities And AI Exposure Defaults
records.notes: AI default list/get/status/preview/diagnostics only; run requires explicit allowlist; delete/restore/credential/recovery disabled by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Plan Export / Import (No Secrets)
records.notes: Plan definitions export without credentials/recovery keys; imported plans bind new Vault references; package movement owned by Surface 26. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.3, §10; docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md §17.

records.label: Privacy / Personal Data In Backup Artifacts
records.notes: WordPress privacy tooling is the native reference; backups contain personal data, so encryption, retention and access controls apply; erasure requests do not silently rewrite immutable backups. Evidence: docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md §19; docs/PRODUCT/BACKUP-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md native audit list.

records.label: Accessible Progress / Resumable Run Detail
records.notes: Progress not colour-only, percentage only when measurable, keyboard wizard, focus-managed destructive confirmation, leave-and-resume via run detail, no fake completion on browser close. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: Archive Exit Code As Verified Success
records.notes: Rejected: capture, local verification, remote persistence, remote verification and restore-tested confidence stay distinct; partial/unverified never shown as generic green success. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §1; docs/PRODUCT/BACKUP-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md rejected list.

records.label: Disable Manifest / Checksums
records.notes: Rejected: manifest and SHA-256 checksums are mandatory and cannot be disabled. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 5; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-ARTIFACT-CONTAINER-COMPRESSION-HASH-PROFILE.md §5.

records.label: Weak ZIP Password Mode As Secure Encryption
records.notes: Rejected: only reviewed authenticated encryption is presented as backup encryption. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 5; docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md §3.

records.label: Follow Symlinks Outside Site Root
records.notes: Rejected: unavailable in normal mode; loops prevented. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 4; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Exclusion rules.

records.label: Restore Without Integrity / Decryption / Environment Preflight
records.notes: Rejected: preflight blockers run read-only before any destructive phase. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Restore preflight; docs/PRODUCT/BACKUP-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md rejected list.

records.label: Destructive Restore Without Verified Backup And Explicit Confirmation
records.notes: Rejected: verified source plus explicit final confirmation (and pre-restore point by default) are required. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7 Pre-restore point, Confirmation.

records.label: Destructive Mirror / Delete Without Impact Preview
records.notes: Rejected: mirror removal of extras and bulk deletes require preview. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.2, §7 Existing target behavior.

records.label: Delete Only Verified / Protected Recovery Point
records.notes: Rejected: protected and last verified points survive retention and bulk delete against policy. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2.2, §8; docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-REMOTE-COPY-LIFECYCLE.md §11.

records.label: Reveal Destination Credentials / Recovery Keys
records.notes: Rejected: write-only Vault references; recovery keys never emailed/uploaded automatically or logged. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Credential fields; docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md §9.

records.label: Encryption Key Stored With Or Derived Beside The Archive
records.notes: Rejected: key and encrypted data are never inseparably stored together; DEK never derived from salts, passwords, URL or provider credentials. Evidence: docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md §2; docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ENCRYPTION-CRYPTO-PROFILE-CANDIDATE.md Backup Set DEK.

records.label: Generic Merge Of Arbitrary Serialized / Foreign Data
records.notes: Rejected: merge is not ordinary restore; no arbitrary SQL from untrusted backups. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Database restore semantics; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: Raw String Replace Of Serialized Data
records.notes: Rejected: serialization-safe typed replacement only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md URL/path migration.

records.label: Ignore TLS / Skip Certificate Validation
records.notes: Rejected: TLS validation mandatory by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-MATRIX.md Security boundaries 4; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 S3-compatible family.

records.label: Skip SFTP Host-Key Verification
records.notes: Rejected: host-key verification is mandatory. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-MATRIX.md Security boundaries 5; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 SFTP.

records.label: Plain FTP As Default Or Secure Transport
records.notes: Rejected: legacy/insecure label plus explicit acknowledgement only; no wording implying encryption in transit. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-LOCAL-FTP-SFTP-STATIC-PROFILES.md §5.

records.label: Long-Running Backup / Restore In A Normal Request
records.notes: Rejected: phased Job Service work only. Evidence: docs/PRODUCT/BACKUP-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md rejected list; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Upload Complete Claimed Without Remote Verification
records.notes: Rejected: upload, commit and verification are separate remote copy states. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-REMOTE-COPY-LIFECYCLE.md §1; docs/PRODUCT/BACKUP-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md rejected list.

records.label: Public / Web-Accessible Archive URLs
records.notes: Rejected: archives live in private non-web-accessible storage; downloads require capability + nonce and never carry secrets in URLs. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-LOCAL-FTP-SFTP-STATIC-PROFILES.md §3, §4; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Local.

records.label: Extract Before Path / Size / Manifest Validation
records.notes: Rejected: path traversal, archive bombs, duplicate paths and forged parts are blocked before extraction. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-CONTAINER-ALTERNATIVES.md Security; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Compression.

records.label: Auto-Download Historical Plugin Versions From Arbitrary Sources
records.notes: Rejected: no automatic downloading of historical paid/proprietary versions. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Plugin/theme handling.

records.label: Disconnect Deletes Remote Backups
records.notes: Rejected: disconnect never means delete; delete/prune is explicit and audited. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-PROVIDER-CERTIFICATION-MATRIX.md Security boundaries 8-9.

records.label: AI Restore / Delete / Credential / Recovery Access By Default
records.notes: Rejected: disabled by default; AI limited to list/get/status/preview/diagnostics. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Silently Exclude User Content By Size
records.notes: Rejected: size exclusion only as an explicit visible user rule recorded in the manifest. Evidence: docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md Exclusion rules; docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3 Step 4.

records.label: Passphrases / DEKs In Options, Logs Or Job Payloads
records.notes: Rejected: never serialized into ordinary job payload tables, options, logs or browser storage. Evidence: docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md §13, §14.

coverage.notes: All 122 Backup records are classified from docs/MODULES/BACKUP-MANAGER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md, docs/MODULES/BACKUP-RESTORE-SEMANTICS.md, the docs/ARCHITECTURE/BACKUP-* profiles, docs/SECURITY/BACKUP-ARCHIVE-ENCRYPTION-KEY-RECOVERY.md and docs/PRODUCT/BACKUP-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md. Native WordPress DB/filesystem/plugin-theme/cron/multisite/maintenance/Site Health primitives are substrate only; manifest + SHA-256 checksums are mandatory, archive encryption is reviewed AEAD with recovery material never stored beside the archive, credentials are Vault references only, destructive restore requires preflight + verified source + explicit confirmation + pre-restore point by default, and archives are never exposed through public URLs; verification tiers, remote copy lifecycle, provider certification, consistency disclosure and prune ordering are WPE-exceed; 10 items are deferred and 24 unsafe patterns stay rejected.
